segments.speaker: Rohit Bansal
segments.text: Chalo shuru karte hain, aaj ka stand-up chhota rakhenge, das minute max.

segments.speaker: Pooja Nair
segments.text: Haan main ready hoon. Kal ka dispatch number pehle bata doon?

segments.speaker: Rohit Bansal
segments.text: Haan bolo, wahi se start karte hain.

segments.speaker: Pooja Nair
segments.text: Kal 412 orders dispatch hue, 38 pending reh gaye kyunki label printer phir se atak gaya tha.

segments.speaker: Imran Qureshi
segments.text: Printer ka roller ghis gaya hai, bahut purana ho chuka hai.

segments.speaker: Rohit Bansal
segments.text: Toh 38 orders abhi bhi pade hain kya?

segments.speaker: Imran Qureshi
segments.text: Nahi, unko manually label karke aaj shaam tak nikal denge, chinta mat karo.

segments.speaker: Rohit Bansal
segments.text: Theek hai. Sneha, returns ka kya scene hai?

segments.speaker: Sneha Kulkarni
segments.text: COD orders mein RTO badh raha hai, pichhle hafte fourteen percent tha.

segments.speaker: Rohit Bansal
segments.text: Fourteen? Ye toh bahut zyada hai yaar. Kahan se aa raha hai zyada?

segments.speaker: Sneha Kulkarni
segments.text: Mostly tier three towns se, aur wahi customers jo delivery boy ka phone nahi uthate.

segments.speaker: Pooja Nair
segments.text: Ek idea hai, COD pe pachas rupaye extra charge laga dete hain, log prepaid karenge.

segments.speaker: Sneha Kulkarni
segments.text: Usse conversion gir jaayega. Pichhli baar try kiya tha toh orders almost aadhe ho gaye the.

segments.speaker: Imran Qureshi
segments.text: Haan mujhe yaad hai, us mahine warehouse khali baitha tha.

segments.speaker: Rohit Bansal
segments.text: Nahi, COD charge abhi nahi lagayenge, woh idea yahin chhod dete hain.

segments.speaker: Pooja Nair
segments.text: Okay, no problem, bas suggestion tha.

segments.speaker: Rohit Bansal
segments.text: Uski jagah kya kar sakte hain jo jaldi ho jaaye?

segments.speaker: Sneha Kulkarni
segments.text: Dispatch se pehle customer ko ek confirmation SMS bhej sakte hain, reply aaye tabhi parcel nikle.

segments.speaker: Imran Qureshi
segments.text: Calling ke liye banda chahiye hota, SMS mein toh koi manpower nahi lagega.

segments.speaker: Pooja Nair
segments.text: Aur jo reply nahi karega uska order hold pe rahega?

segments.speaker: Sneha Kulkarni
segments.text: Haan, chaubis ghante hold, phir cancel.

segments.speaker: Rohit Bansal
segments.text: Done. Toh decide karte hain, ab se har COD order pe dispatch se pehle confirmation SMS jayega.

segments.speaker: Pooja Nair
segments.text: Theek hai, main packing team ko bata dungi ki hold wale orders alag rakhein.

segments.speaker: Rohit Bansal
segments.text: SMS ka message kaun likhega? Template chahiye pehle.

segments.speaker: Sneha Kulkarni
segments.text: Template main bana deti hoon, woh simple hai.

segments.speaker: Rohit Bansal
segments.text: Sneha, template kal tak final karke mujhe bhej dena, main approve kar dunga.

segments.speaker: Sneha Kulkarni
segments.text: Haan, kal tak bhej dungi.

segments.speaker: Rohit Bansal
segments.text: Aur ek cheez, jin pincodes se sabse zyada RTO aa raha hai unki list chahiye.

segments.speaker: Imran Qureshi
segments.text: Woh courier panel se nikal sakte hain, thoda time lagta hai bas.

segments.speaker: Rohit Bansal
segments.text: Koi bhi nikal de, mujhe farak nahi padta kaun, bas Friday tak list chahiye.

segments.speaker: Pooja Nair
segments.text: Main is hafte audit mein phasi hoon, mujhse mat expect karna.

segments.speaker: Sneha Kulkarni
segments.text: Mere paas bhi template aur returns dono hain.

segments.speaker: Rohit Bansal
segments.text: Theek hai, koi na koi kar lega, Friday tak pincode list aa jaani chahiye.

segments.speaker: Imran Qureshi
segments.text: Printer pe wapas aate hain, roller ka jugaad kab tak chalega?

segments.speaker: Imran Qureshi
segments.text: Technician bola hai Thursday ko aayega, par mujhe lagta hai naya printer hi lena padega.

segments.speaker: Rohit Bansal
segments.text: Imran, naye label printer ka quotation le aao, do teen vendors se.

segments.speaker: Imran Qureshi
segments.text: Haan main quotation le aata hoon, technician Thursday ko jo bolega woh bhi saath rakh dunga.

segments.speaker: Rohit Bansal
segments.text: Theek. Quotation ki koi jaldi nahi hai, bas comparison proper hona chahiye.

segments.speaker: Pooja Nair
segments.text: Ek side point, Diwali ka stock kal se aana shuru hoga, racks khaali karne padenge.

segments.speaker: Imran Qureshi
segments.text: Woh main dekh lunga, rack B aur C khaali hain already.

segments.speaker: Rohit Bansal
segments.text: Good. Saturday ka dispatch is baar chalu rakhenge na?

segments.speaker: Pooja Nair
segments.text: Haan, festive season hai, Saturday ko bhi half day dispatch chalega.

segments.speaker: Rohit Bansal
segments.text: Theek hai, toh Saturday half day dispatch final, sabko roster mein daal do.

segments.speaker: Pooja Nair
segments.text: Roster aaj update kar deti hoon.

segments.speaker: Sneha Kulkarni
segments.text: Ek last cheez, returns wale parcels ka QC kaun karega abhi?

segments.speaker: Imran Qureshi
segments.text: Abhi Pappu bhaiya kar rahe hain, woh theek chal raha hai.

segments.speaker: Rohit Bansal
segments.text: Chalo, wahi chalne do. Aur kuch?

segments.speaker: Pooja Nair
segments.text: Mere side se bas itna hi.

segments.speaker: Sneha Kulkarni
segments.text: Nahi, sab clear hai.

segments.speaker: Rohit Bansal
segments.text: Theek hai sab log, thank you, kal same time milte hain.

decisions.fact: Every cash-on-delivery order gets a confirmation text before it is dispatched.
Dispatch runs a half day on Saturdays during the festive season.

action_items.fact: Sneha finalises the SMS template and sends it to Rohit for approval.
Someone pulls the list of pincodes with the most returns; nobody named.
Imran gets quotations for a new label printer from a few vendors.

distractors.fact: A Rs 50 extra charge on COD orders was suggested and dropped.
Thursday is the technician's visit, not the quotation's due date.
